Rhode Island toy company that owns G.I. Joe and launched the 3¾-inch line.

How Hasbro connects

  • Topic: G.I. Joe — Hasbro created G.I. Joe and still owns the line.
  • Work: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero — Hasbro relaunched G.I. Joe as A Real American Hero in 1982.
  • Work: G.I. Joe (1964) — Hasbro launched the 12-inch G.I. Joe in 1964.

What is Hasbro?

Hasbro created the original 12-inch G.I. Joe in 1964 and rebuilt the brand in 1982 as A Real American Hero, pairing small figures with Marvel comics, file cards, and vehicles.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe, G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero and G.I. Joe (1964).
